## Description

Implements the ic-preparation activity (S11) report drafting: shaping an IC report from an approved sample structure so that sections, evidence references and the verified / could not verify / needs judgement split stay consistent. Does not author analysis content or build the deck (executive-presentation). Use when: "report writing", "sample report", "report drafting", "IC report structure".
